The capture masked the member/household/locality counts with '•' glyphs, narrower than digits, so the reference rows are narrower (width30/width5 90 px vs 115 px, icon margins in %). Replacing the clone's counts with the captured masked strings gives exactly the reference geometry (row 0: 89.8 px, offset 118; row 1: 129.4 px, offset 98). On Assemble_BrowseByCountry the same block sits inside .backwards-compatibility (full-width inline-flex rows), so masking does not move it. Text diffs are 0. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15
